name: e-chat
description: e-Chat is an advanced artificial intelligence chatbot, meticulously designed and developed by Efatha Rutakaza. From academic inquiries to technical problem-solving and general knowledge exploration, e-Chat ensures reliable and precise responses, making it a versatile tool for diverse users.
